author: PavelMakarchuk
body: Tracked upstream: PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#8494. Root cause is PE-US's `taxable_unemployment_compensation` collapsing the entire tax unit's taxable UI onto the head, which gives the no-income spouse phantom AGI (here ~$8,500) and lets them claim a separate KY standard deduction under the combined-return optimization. With per-person UI preserved, KY tax reproduces to ~$524.
